crm_at_risk@crm.active: To identify 'OPEN' deals, consider stages like 'qualified' and 'negotiation'. 'At risk' deals are indicated by 'health' status 'A' or 'R'. Remember to paginate through all results from crm.list_deals and use crm.get_owner to resolve owner IDs.
